label: Рука
description: A usage card for рука walking the full case ladder with everyday collocations.

missions.phrase: Сегодня у меня сильно болит рука.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Рука' is the subject in its dictionary form. 2. 'Болит' is a high-frequency verb of physical state agreeing with it. 3. The nominative names what hurts before any case shift.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement, nominative. 1. 'Рука' stays the nominative subject. 2. 'Правая' and 'моя' both agree in feminine singular nominative. 3. The modifiers drill agreement endings without changing the noun's role.
Strategic focus: Predicate adjective, nominative. 1. 'Рука' is the nominative subject. 2. 'Левая' modifies it in agreement. 3. 'Сильная' is the predicate adjective, all feminine singular nominative.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Руку' is the direct-object form. 2. 'Поднял' is a concrete past-tense verb taking it. 3. The accusative marks the thing acted upon.

Strategic focus: Accusative in a fixed collocation. 1. 'Руку' is the object of the handshake. 2. 'Пожать' pairs almost exclusively with this noun. 3. A social idiom worth memorizing whole in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Accusative with full agreement. 1. 'Руку' is the object form. 2. 'Правую' and 'мою' both agree in feminine singular accusative. 3. Two modifiers track the same ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 1. 'Руки' shows the genitive ending. 2. It tells whose colour is meant, linking it to 'цвет'. 3. The genitive joins one noun to another.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 1. 'Руки' follows 'нет' and takes the genitive. 2. 'У этой статуи' frames the possession. 3. Absence forces the genitive form.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 1. 'Руке' is the dative beneficiary of the action. 2. 'Помог' is a high-value verb that governs the dative. 3. Small but grammatically rich.
Strategic focus: Dative of experiencer. 1. 'Руке' is dative, the thing feeling the warmth. 2. 'Тепло' is an impersonal predicate. 3. The dative names who or what experiences a state.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 1. 'Рукой' is the instrumental form. 2. 'Пишу' is first-person present. 3. The instrumental names the tool with which the action is done.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with agreement. 1. 'Рукой' is the instrumental of means. 2. 'Сильной' agrees in feminine singular instrumental. 3. 'Взял' shows the past action performed by that means.
Strategic focus: Prepositional scene. 1. 'Руке' takes the prepositional after 'в'. 2. 'Держать' is the infinitive of holding. 3. The phrase locates the object inside the hand.

missions.phrase: У неё в руке была книга.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 1. 'Руке' follows 'в' in the prepositional. 2. 'Книга' is the nominative subject placed there. 3. The scene shows where something rests.

missions.phrase: После работы у меня болят руки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 1. 'Руки' is the plural subject form. 2. 'Болят' agrees with it as plural. 3. The whole pair of hands is now in view.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 1. 'Руках' is the prepositional plural after 'в'. 2. 'Мама' is the nominative subject doing the carrying. 3. A common idiom for holding someone.
Strategic focus: Plural idiom with agreement. 1. 'Руки' is the nominative plural. 2. 'Золотые' agrees in plural. 3. The pair names a skilled, capable person.

missions.phrase: Перед обедом надо мыть руки тёплой водой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural plus instrumental. 1. 'Руки' is the accusative plural object. 2. 'Мыть' is the infinitive governing it. 3. 'Тёплой водой' names the means in the instrumental.
